subject: POC workbench session — hands-on lab coordination & pre-reads
messages:
From: Alex Monroe <alex@cloudbeam.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Reed <sam.reed@heliosai.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial POC plan — hands-on session request

Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. CloudBeam is excited to move to a short, focused POC that includes a hands-on workbench session where we:
- validate prompt templates across our common user flows (search, summarize, rewrite)
- test routing policies (low-cost vs low-latency variants)
- run two brief load tests to exercise batch/latency SLO behavior

Can your team run a 2.5–3 hour working session next week? Ideal attendees from our side: myself (product), Sam (infrastructure), and our SRE lead (TBD). Our timezone is PST.

Goal for the session: get a working prompt set into Redwood, route a small test traffic stream, and collect token-level latency/cost metrics.

Let me know available slots and any pre-reads we should review.

—Alex
Product Lead
CloudBeam

Attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Monroe <alex@cloudbeam.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial POC plan — hands-on session request

Alex — thanks for the clear goals. Ben and I can run the workbench session. Proposed plan below and attached is a short agenda + checklist: POC_Workbench_Agenda_v1.pdf and lab-prep-checklist.md.

Proposed session (2.5 hrs):
1) 15m intro & alignment (success criteria / roles)
2) 40m prompt review & live editing (we'll import your prompt set)
3) 35m routing & variant walkthrough (policy mapping, fallback)
4) 30m load/light soak test (we'll run 500–1k small requests, measure p95/p99)
5) 20m results review + next steps + action items

Pre-reads (please skim):
- Agenda PDF (attached)
- lab-prep-checklist.md (attached) — includes account access notes and a small prompt-samples.csv template to populate
- Short note on sample traffic shape: we recommend 70% short-generation, 30% long-context for your flows

Available slots (PST):
- Tue Nov 24 — 10:00–12:30 or 13:00–15:30
- Wed Nov 25 — 09:00–11:30
- Fri Nov 27 — 11:00–13:30

If none work, tell us preferred days/times and we'll reschedule promptly. I can also share a single calendar invite link once we lock a slot.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: POC_Workbench_Agenda_v1.pdf, lab-prep-checklist.md

Also: could you add a short checklist item to the pre-reads with instructions for our API keys and network egress requirements? We want to make sure the private endpoint setup is ready before the session.
